The licence is MPL-2.0 (as given in the list). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support optimisation-based planning and operation studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-best-of-ps.
